title: Profit and Loss
description: Practice cost price, selling price, profit margin, and discount percentage problems.
instructions: Identify Cost Price (CP) and Selling Price (SP) clearly before applying formulas.

questions.question: A book is bought for ₹250 and sold for ₹300. What is the profit percentage?
An item with a marked price of ₹800 is sold at a 15% discount. What is the selling price?
If selling an article for ₹720 results in a 10% loss, what was its cost price?
If the cost price of 10 pens equals the selling price of 8 pens, what is the profit percentage?
